description.en: A description of the watermark job.

description.zh:
待添加水印的视频文件。

> - OSS文件/媒资的地域需要与当前IMS所在地域保持一致。
description.en:
The input video file to be watermarked.

> - The OSS object or media asset must be in the same region as the service call.

description.zh: 水印级别，取值0/1/2，表示嵌入通道，0u，1uv，2yuv。
description.en: The watermark level, which specifies the embedding channel. Valid values are 0, 1, and 2, which correspond to the U, UV, and YUV channels, respectively.

description.zh:
输出文件地址。

> - OSS的地域需要与当前IMS所在地域保持一致。
description.en:
The location of the output file.

> - The OSS bucket must be in the same region as the service call.

description.zh:
水印任务参数，JSONString。目前支持设置参数如下：

- algoType：算法类型，默认值为v1。
  - v1：长视频版权水印，仅支持3min以上的。
  - v2：短视频版权水印。
description.en:
The parameters for the watermark job, specified as a JSON string. The following parameter is supported:

- `algoType`: The algorithm type. Defaults to `v1`.

  - `v1`: For videos 3 minutes or longer.

  - `v2`: For short videos.

description.zh: 水印起始时间，单位为秒，不填写默认为0。
description.en: The start time of the watermark in seconds. Defaults to 0.

description.zh: 水印结束时间，单位为秒，不填写默认为视频时长。
description.en: The end time of the watermark in seconds. If unspecified, the watermark is applied until the video ends.

description.zh: 用户自定义数据，最大长度1024字节。
description.en: The user data. The value can be up to 1,024 bytes in length.

title.zh: 提交视频版权水印作业

descriptions.zh:
- 提交视频版权水印作业默认仅支持3分钟及以上视频，视频时间过短会导致接口调用失败或无输出。如果需要对3分钟以内的短视频添加版权水印，可以通过Params参数指定，详见参数描述。

- 提交视频版权水印作业每次接口的调用，都是对独立视频进行添加水印，不支持多个视频同时提交。

- 目前数字水印相关接口只支持华东2（上海）、华北 2（北京）地域使用。

- 该接口为[异步接口](~~3027141~~)，提交任务后返回任务ID（此时任务尚未完成，任务将进入后台排队异步执行），最终结果将通过回调通知，也可通过[查询视频版权水印作业列表](~~2862135~~)主动查询任务状态。
descriptions.en:
- By default, this operation supports only videos 3 minutes or longer. Submitting a job for a shorter video may fail or produce no output. To watermark shorter videos, use the `Params` parameter.

- You can submit a watermark job for only one video per API call.

- Currently, digital watermark-related APIs are available only in the China (Shanghai) and China (Beijing) regions.

- This is an [asynchronous interface](~~3027141~~). After you submit a job, the system returns a job ID and queues the job for background processing. Results are delivered via callback notification. Alternatively, you can call the [Query Video Copyright Job List](~~2862135~~) operation to check the job status.
